claims.supports: Raw solver attempts and batch structure are unsuitable as durable semantic obligation identity without a stronger explicit contract.
Silver is shared across symbolic-execution and VCG backends, so a raw VC is not Viper's universal verification-work representation.
Viper's shared result/orchestration surfaces preserve source/error provenance above backend-specific proof-search state.
Anneal should add semantic obligation descriptors only if it owns sub-stage obligation policy; otherwise whole-stage generation identity is simpler and sufficient.
